newsitem.title: USA: Connecticut Energy sees higher Q4 results.
newsitem.headline: Connecticut Energy sees higher Q4 results.

text.p: Connecticut Energy Corp said Wednesday it expects improved results in its fourth quarter versus a year ago, and sees full year results in line with analysts' estimates.
Connecticut Energy today reported a third quarter loss of $0.13 a share, against a year-ago loss of $0.08. Analysts had expected a loss of $0.08 a share, according to First Call.
The company typically loses money in the third and fourth quarters because a large portion of its annual margin comes from space heating during the winter months.
Connecticut Energy has earned $2.14 per share for the first nine months of fiscal 1997, compared to $2.13 for the same period last year.
According to First Call's consensus estimate, analysts expect full-year earnings at the company of $1.74 per share.

"We anticipate improved results over last year in the fourth quarter," Chief Financial Officer Carol Forest said in a statement. "We are comfortable that our fiscal year 1997 earnings will be in line with analysts' expectations."
